##


Bank of America cardholders and BofA Rewards members have access to one-of-a-kind experiences and curated benefits at one of the nation’s premier food and drink festivals


## Key points


- Partnership with New York City Wine & Food Festival showcases Bank of America’s expanding portfolio of lifestyle experiences for cardholders and B of A

- Curated dining experiences for B of A

NEW YORK, New York


N.Y.


– As the Official Bank Partner of the[Food Network New York City Wine & Food Festival presented by Invesco Q Q Q QQQ](https://nycwff.org/) ( N Y C W F F


NYCWFF


), Bank of America is bringing cardholders and B of A


BofA


Rewards members exclusive event access and premium experiences that celebrate New York City’s world-class dining scene. N Y C W F F


NYCWFF


takes place October fifteenth through the eighteenth twenty twenty six


Oct. 15-18, 2026


, at[The Seaport](https://theseaport.nyc/) .


New York City ranks among the country’s strongest markets for restaurant spending growth, according to[Bank of America Institute](https://institute.bankofamerica.com/economic-insights/restaurants-and-discretionary-spending.html) analysis. Gen Z is driving restaurant spending, recording the fastest restaurant spending growth of any generation and underscoring consumers’ continued appetite for dining and experiences.


*“Clients value experiences that go beyond traditional banking benefits,”* said **Mary Hines Droesch, Head of Consumer & Small Business Products at Bank of America** . *“Through our partnership with N Y C W F F NYCWFF , we’re bringing together dining, entertainment and lifestyle benefits to create memorable moments for our cardholders and B of A BofA Rewards members.”*


## Unlocking more at N Y C W F F


NYCWFF


for cardholders


[Bank of America cardholders](https://www.bankofamerica.com/credit-cards/) enjoy enhanced access throughout N Y C W F F


NYCWFF


, making it easier to experience some of the festival’s most popular events. Benefits, subject to availability, include:


- 45-minute early entry to select N Y C W F F


NYCWFF


events
- fifteen percent


15%


off Grand Tasting tickets, N Y C W F F’s


NYCWFF’s


signature event
- Select cardholder-exclusive dining experiences


## The B of A


BofA


Rewards Lounge experience


Located within the Norwegian Cruise Line Rooftop Series at The Rooftop at Pier 17, the B of A


BofA


Rewards Lounge gives cardholders attending Rooftop Series events a firsthand look at the exclusive experiences, access and lifestyle benefits available through B of A


BofA


Rewards, including:


- Dedicated lounge space to relax and recharge for Rooftop Series attendees.
- Experiences from B of A


BofA


Rewards food-focused lifestyle benefits partners, including[Gradito](https://www.gradito.com/) ,[Levain Bakery™](https://levainbakery.com/?srsltid=AU7gw4VD6HcRebSOFd64_3mq1hAIo7rnSTsaqtis_P8n2XmqTCpD8o0H) and more.
- Opportunities to discover the benefits and experiences available through B of A


BofA


Rewards.


For details on Rooftop Series tickets, visit[N Y C W F F NYCWFF Rooftop Series](https://nycwff.org/event-type/rooftop-series/) .


## Exclusive dining experiences for Premier tier members


The B of A


BofA


Rewards Premier Tier Dining Series offers Premier tier members access to unique culinary experiences highlighting local restaurants that make New York one of the world’s leading dining destinations. The Dining Series, available on a limited basis while spots remain, features:


- Intimate dining experiences with Nadav Greenberg of Or’esh, Flynn McGarry of Cove, and Korean-American fried chicken and champagne concept COQODAQ.
- Access to hard-to-get restaurants and exclusive dining opportunities.
- One-of-a-kind experiences that connect members with New York’s food, culture and hospitality scene.


Cardholders and B of A


BofA


Rewards members can visit[N Y C W F F NYCWFF Bank of America](https://nycwff.org/event-type/bofa/) to view eligible events, ticket availability, benefits and additional details about Bank of America’s N Y C W F F


NYCWFF


offerings.


## Frequently asked questions


### Question: Who is eligible for N Y C W F F


NYCWFF


benefits through Bank of America?


**Answer:** Eligible Bank of America consumer and small business credit and debit cardholders can access select N Y C W F F


NYCWFF


benefits, including early entry to signature events, savings on Grand Tasting tickets and access to the B of A


BofA


Rewards Lounge at the Rooftop at Pier 17. Additional benefits, including the B of A


BofA


Rewards Dining Series, are available exclusively to eligible B of A


BofA


Rewards Premier tier members. All offers are subject to availability – while supplies last.


### Question: What is B of A


BofA


Rewards?


**Answer:** B of A


BofA


Rewards is Bank of America's no fee, relationship-based rewards program that provides eligible members with enhanced banking, investing and lifestyle benefits. Depending on tier status, members can receive valuable rewards and gain access to exclusive experiences, including premier dining, travel and entertainment opportunities. For more details and to learn how to join, visit:[B of A BofA Rewards](https://bofa.com/bofarewards) .


### Question: Where can cardholders and B of A


BofA


Rewards members find information about available events and benefits?


**Answer:** Cardholders can visit[N Y C W F F NYCWFF Bank of America](https://nycwff.org/event-type/bofa/) to view eligible events, ticket availability, cardholder benefits and additional details about Bank of America's N Y C W F F


NYCWFF


offerings.


### Question: Why is Bank of America partnering with N Y C W F F


NYCWFF


?


**Answer:** Bank of America is continuing to expand access to premium dining, travel and lifestyle experiences through B of A


BofA


Rewards. The partnership with N Y C W F F


NYCWFF


brings that strategy to life, offering cardholders and B of A


BofA


Rewards members access to exclusive culinary events and unique experiences at one of the country’s premier food festivals. In addition, the Festival aligns with our commitment to helping drive economic opportunity and supporting nonprofit organizations that are making a meaningful impact in the communities we serve.


## Bank of America


Bank of America is one of the world’s leading financial institutions, serving individual consumers, small and middle-market businesses and large corporations with a full range of banking, investing, asset management and other financial and risk management products and services. The company provides unmatched convenience in the United States, serving more than 69 million clients with approximately 3,500 retail financial centers, approximately 15,000 A T Ms


ATMs


(automated teller machines) and award-winning digital banking with approximately 60 million verified digital users. Bank of America is a global leader in wealth management, corporate and investment banking and trading across a broad range of asset classes, serving corporations, governments, institutions and individuals around the world. As the #1 small business lender in the United States ( F D I C


FDIC


), Bank of America offers industry-leading support to approximately 4 million small business households through a suite of innovative, easy-to-use online products and services. The company serves clients through operations across the United States, its territories and more than 35 countries and/or jurisdictions. Bank of America Corporation stock ( N Y S E


NYSE


: B A C


BAC


) is listed on the New York Stock Exchange.
